sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐秘。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine building a city from scratch.
sentences.zh: 从零开始建造一座城市很难想象。

sentences.en: I just remember the difference between the first time I went there when it was just a little mud hole.
sentences.zh: 我只记得我第一次去那里时的情景，那时它还只是个小泥坑。

sentences.en: Just didn't look like it had very much potential at all.
sentences.zh: 完全看不出有什么发展潜力。

sentences.en: Turning a little mud hole into a full-service city, it takes an incredible amount of resources and people and moxie.
sentences.zh: 要把一个小泥坑变成一个功能齐全的城市，需要难以想象的资源、人力和冲劲。

sentences.en: That's reporter Chloe Prasinos.
sentences.zh: 这是记者克洛伊·普拉西诺斯。

sentences.en: And the other voice you just heard is Milt Ritter.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚听到的另一个声音是米尔特·里特尔。

sentences.en: Okay, my name is Milt Ritter.
sentences.zh: 好的，我叫米尔特·里特尔。

sentences.en: Ritter is a journaliSt. He covered the story of Rajneesh Puram, which was a city that popped up in Oregon in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 里特尔是一名记者。他报道了拉杰尼什普拉姆的故事，这是一座在20世纪80年代突然出现在俄勒冈州的城市。

sentences.en: I mean, it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太神奇了。

sentences.en: You know, it was slightly breathtaking driving down into the canyon after a few years compared to what it was.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，几年后再开车开进峡谷，与过去相比简直让人叹为观止。

sentences.en: Rajneesh Puram wasn't trying to be any American city.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼什普拉姆并不是想成为任何一个美国城市。

sentences.en: They are trying to build a utopia guided by New Age religious principles.
sentences.zh: 他们试图在「新时代」宗教原则的指导下建立一个乌托邦。

sentences.en: A place where people of like mind could abandon the mainstream and live their own way.
sentences.zh: 一个志同道合的人可以抛弃主流、按自己的方式生活的地方。

sentences.en: And almost as quickly as this place went from mud hole to city, it went from utopia to dystopia.
sentences.zh: 几乎就在这个地方从泥坑变成城市的同时，它从乌托邦变成了反乌托邦。

sentences.en: There's been a couple of big stories that I covered in my lifetime.
sentences.zh: 这是我一生中报道过的几个重大故事之一。

sentences.en: The eruption of Mount St. Helens was one of them and the Rajneesh Puram was the other, you know.
sentences.zh: 圣海伦火山爆发是一个，拉杰尼什普拉姆是另一个，你知道的。

sentences.en: It was crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: The story really begins with one man, an Indian guru named Bhagwan Sri Rajneesh.
sentences.zh: 故事其实从一个人开始，一个名叫巴关·施里·拉杰尼什的印度大师。

sentences.en: His name loosely translates to Sir God.
sentences.zh: 他的名字大致翻译过来就是“神圣之主”。

sentences.en: Bhagwan Sri Rajneesh is a mystic from India, and he's what we would refer to as an enlightened being.
sentences.zh: 巴关·施里·拉杰尼什是一位来自印度的神秘主义者，也就是我们所说的开悟者。

sentences.en: That's Ma Ananda Sarita.
sentences.zh: 那是玛·阿南达·萨里塔。

sentences.en: When she was 17, she ran away from home and traveled the world, looking for what she calls the essence of life.
sentences.zh: 17岁时，她离家出走并周游世界，寻找她所谓的生命本质。

sentences.en: Sarita found it in India when she met Bhagwan Sri Rajneesh.
sentences.zh: 萨里塔在印度遇到了巴关·施里·拉杰尼什，并在那里找到了它。

sentences.en: So, of course, you've heard of Jesus, you've heard of Buddha, those would be considered as enlightened beings.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，你听说过耶稣，听说过佛陀，这些都可以被视为开悟者。

sentences.en: Rajneesh was a philosophy professor come guru.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼什是一位由哲学教授转变为大师的人。

sentences.en: He synthesized Eastern and Western spiritual thought and psychotherapy and created his own brand of spirituality.
sentences.zh: 他融合了东西方精神思想与心理疗法，创立了自己独特的灵性流派。

sentences.en: He said, you cannot make a dogma out of my words.
sentences.zh: 他说，你不能把我的话变成教条。

sentences.en: As far as I could tell, his religion was a non-religion.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，他的宗教是一个非宗教。

sentences.en: Here's archival tape of Bhagwan Sri Rajneesh from the Oregon Historical Society.
sentences.zh: 这里是俄勒冈历史学会保存的巴关·施里·拉杰尼什的档案录音。

sentences.en: We'll be hearing tape from their archive throughout this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们在本集中将一直听到他们档案中的录音。

sentences.en: It is not a way of prayer.
sentences.zh: 这不是一种祈祷方式。

sentences.en: It is a way of living.
sentences.zh: 这是一种生活方式。

sentences.en: The guru's way of life basically trashed all the difficult stuff about religion, all the chastity and abstinence and discipline and shame,
sentences.zh: 这位大师的生活方式基本上抛弃了宗教中所有艰难的部分，所有的贞洁、禁欲、纪律和羞耻，

sentences.en: and instead curated a spirituality of sex, laughter, and luxury, which, as you can imagine, sounded pretty appealing to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 转而推崇一种包含性、笑声和奢华的灵性，你可以想象，这对许多人来说听起来相当有吸引力。

sentences.en: Rajneesh had a meditation center in India, where in the 70s, lots of Westerners paid good money for spiritual instruction.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼什在印度有一个静修中心，在70年代，许多西方人花大把的钱来寻求灵性指导。

sentences.en: Rajneesh's disciples dressed in red clothing and wore lockets with his photo inside.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼什的信徒身穿红衣，戴着镶有他照片的挂坠。

sentences.en: They called themselves sannyasins, a Hindu term for a kind of spiritual seeker.
sentences.zh: 他们自称三尼辛，这是一个源自印度教的词，指某种灵性寻求者。

sentences.en: They even took new names given to them by the guru.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至采用由大师赐予的新名字。

sentences.en: The women were given the title ma, the men were referred to as swami.
sentences.zh: 女性被赋予“玛”的称号，男性则被称为“斯瓦米”。

sentences.en: And the sannyasins weren't just disciples.
sentences.zh: 而且三尼辛不只是信徒。

sentences.en: They claimed to be in love with their guru.
sentences.zh: 他们声称爱着他们的导师。

sentences.en: Bhagwan is my master and I love him.
sentences.zh: 巴关是我的师尊，我爱他。

sentences.en: Bhagwan's my master.
sentences.zh: 巴关是我的师尊。

sentences.en: He was infinitely graceful.
sentences.zh: 他风度翩翩，无可挑剔。

sentences.en: And in his eyes, one could experience the whole universe pulsing there, throbbing alive.
sentences.zh: 在他的眼眸中，人们可以体验到整个宇宙在那里脉动、勃勃生机。

sentences.en: Rajneesh was known for a technique called dynamic meditation.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼什以一种被称为动态冥想的技术而闻名。

sentences.en: It was intended to quiet the mind.
sentences.zh: 其目的是让心灵平静下来。

sentences.en: Practitioners close their eyes and concentrate on their breathing.
sentences.zh: 练习者闭上眼睛，专注于呼吸。

sentences.en: Then they explode.
sentences.zh: 然后他们爆发。

sentences.en: They scream, jump, kick, dance, writhe.
sentences.zh: 他们尖叫、跳跃、踢腿、舞蹈、翻滚。

sentences.en: Then comes a mantra.
sentences.zh: 接着是念诵咒语。

sentences.en: And then, silence.
sentences.zh: 然后，归于寂静。

sentences.en: In 1981, Rajneesh was basically kicked out of India.
sentences.zh: 1981年，拉杰尼什基本上被印度驱逐出境。

sentences.en: There were accusations that his ashram was a business, not a religious institution.
sentences.zh: 当时有指控称他的静修所是一桩生意，而不是一个宗教机构。

sentences.en: Which would mean he owed several million dollars in back taxes.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他欠下了数百万美元的滞纳税款。

sentences.en: So the guru and his followers started looking for a new home base.
sentences.zh: 于是这位大师和他的追随者开始寻找新的根据地。

sentences.en: And they found it in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们在美国找到了。

sentences.en: A 64,000 acre ranch way out in the range country of north central Oregon.
sentences.zh: 那是俄勒冈州中北部牧场腹地的一座占地6万4千英亩的牧场。

sentences.en: Soon after they arrived, Milt Ritter went out to investigate.
sentences.zh: 他们抵达后不久，米尔特·里特尔便前往调查。

sentences.en: When we first took that trip, it was almost like, really, is this right?
sentences.zh: 当我们第一次进行那次旅行时，几乎感觉像是，真的吗，这是对的吗？

sentences.en: You know, are we headed in the right direction?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们走的方向对吗？

sentences.en: This just seems so out there.
sentences.zh: 这感觉太偏远了。

sentences.en: And it was hard to understand what a guru from India would want in a place like this.
sentences.zh: 而且很难理解一个来自印度的精神导师为什么会想要这样一个地方。

sentences.en: The first time I met the Rajneesh was in about the second week of July of 1981.
sentences.zh: 我第一次见到拉杰尼什大约是在1981年7月的第二周。

sentences.en: This is Dan Durow.
sentences.zh: 这是丹·杜罗。

sentences.en: He was the Wasco County planner at the time.
sentences.zh: 他当时是沃斯科县的规划师。

sentences.en: And the Sinyasin's new ranch was located in his jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 三尼辛的新牧场就位于他的管辖范围内。

sentences.en: When they first walked into the office, there were just three of them at the time.
sentences.zh: 当他们第一次走进办公室时，当时只有三个人。

sentences.en: And they were quite pleasant.
sentences.zh: 他们非常随和友善。

sentences.en: But they definitely weren't from around there.
sentences.zh: 但他们绝对不是本地人。

sentences.en: They were all dressed in red.
sentences.zh: 他们都穿着红色的衣服。

sentences.en: They had strange names.
sentences.zh: 他们有奇怪的名字。

sentences.en: At one point in the conversation, Durow asked if they were a religious organization.
sentences.zh: 在谈话的某个时候，杜罗问他们是否是一个宗教组织。

sentences.en: And the answer was, oh no, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 回答是，哦不，绝对不是。

sentences.en: We're not a religion.
sentences.zh: 我们不是一个宗教。

sentences.en: We have members who are of all faiths.
sentences.zh: 我们的成员信仰各种不同的宗教。

sentences.en: And we just celebrate life and laughter and happiness.
sentences.zh: 我们只是庆祝生命、笑声和快乐。

sentences.en: And we're just simple farmers.
sentences.zh: 我们只是普通的农民。

sentences.en: Well, that wasn't the case.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And that wasn't, of course, the intent.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也不是他们的意图。

sentences.en: Durow didn't know it yet.
sentences.zh: 杜罗当时还不知道。

sentences.en: But the intent of his visitors was to build a mecca for the guru's followers from across the globe.
sentences.zh: 但他的来访者的真正意图是为来自全球各地的大师追随者建造一座麦加圣地。

sentences.en: In order to build anything, the Sinyasins would have to get permits for every single structure that went up.
sentences.zh: 为了建造任何东西，三尼辛必须为拔地而起的每一栋建筑获得许可。

sentences.en: The mistake, I think, that they made ultimately was to not look at the land use laws of Oregon versus other states.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们最终犯下的错误，是没有去对比俄勒冈州与其他州的土地使用法。

sentences.en: The land the Sinyasins had chosen was zoned specifically for farming.
sentences.zh: 三尼辛选择的土地被专门划为农业用途。

sentences.en: And they weren't going to be able to get permits for buildings that weren't for farm use.
sentences.zh: 他们无法为非农业用途的建筑获得许可证。

sentences.en: But there was a workaround.
sentences.zh: 但有一个变通的方法。

sentences.en: According to state law, if they became their own city, they could have their own planning office and issue their own permits,
sentences.zh: 根据州法律，如果他们成立自己的城市，他们就可以拥有自己的规划办公室并自行颁发许可证，

sentences.en: effectively skirting county oversight and the land use laws.
sentences.zh: 从而有效地规避县级监管和土地使用法。

sentences.en: And in Oregon at the time, to incorporate a city, all you needed was 150 people, which was easy for the Sinyasins.
sentences.zh: 当时的俄勒冈州，要合并一座城市只需要150人，这对三尼辛来说轻而易举。

sentences.en: There really wasn't much to decide.
sentences.zh: 其实没有什么好犹豫的。

sentences.en: Once they met the basic requirements for incorporation, it moved forward.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们满足了成立城市的基本要求，事情就开始推进了。

sentences.en: The Sinyasins named their new city after the guru, Bhagwan Sri Rajneesh.
sentences.zh: 三尼辛以大师的名字来命名他们的新城市：巴关·施里·拉杰尼什。

sentences.en: They called it Rajneeshpuram.
sentences.zh: 他们将其命名为拉杰尼什普拉姆。

sentences.en: It seemed like it happened very quickly that buildings started springing up and gardens started being planted, houses.
sentences.zh: 感觉建筑飞速拔地而起，花园开始种植，房屋也建了起来，这一切发生得非常快。

sentences.en: They scratched out a runway for an airfield and they brought in planes.
sentences.zh: 他们在一片荒地上开辟了一条飞机跑道，并引进了飞机。

sentences.en: The city needed infrastructure to support not just the full-time residents, but visitors too.
sentences.zh: 这座城市需要基础设施来支持全职居民以及游客。

sentences.en: Every summer, thousands of disciples came for Rajneesh's annual festival.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天，成千上万的信徒都会前来参加拉杰尼什的年度节日。

sentences.en: In the off-season, people came to take meditation courses and experience life in the city.
sentences.zh: 在淡季，人们来这里参加冥想课程，体验城市生活。

sentences.en: They built a strip mall and a hotel, buildings for religious ceremonies, a crematorium, a discotheque, a post office.
sentences.zh: 他们建造了一个小型购物中心和一家酒店、用于宗教仪式的建筑、火葬场、迪斯科舞厅和邮局。

sentences.en: Many of the buildings were designed in a rustic, alpine style with wooden siding.
sentences.zh: 许多建筑都采用带有木制护墙板的乡村高山风格设计。

sentences.en: Housing, on the other hand, was built quickly, with lots of prefab A-frame structures littered across the valley.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，住房建设速度极快，山谷中散落着许多预制A字形建筑。

sentences.en: It was amazing at what they were doing, and they were doing it very, very quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们在做的事情令人惊叹，而且进展得非常非常快。

sentences.en: But the ranch's rapid expansion did not go unchecked.
sentences.zh: 但是牧场的迅速扩张并非一帆风顺。

sentences.en: Immediately after Rajneeshpuram became an official city, an Oregon environmental group challenged the incorporation.
sentences.zh: 就在拉杰尼什普拉姆成为正式城市后不久，一个俄勒冈州的环保组织对这一合并提出了质疑。

sentences.en: They saw the attempt to build a big city out in the desert, which was zoned agriculture, as a huge problem for the land use laws.
sentences.zh: 他们认为在划为农业区的沙漠中试图建造一座大城市，是对土地使用法的巨大破坏。

sentences.en: A judge ruled that the sannyasins could keep building their city, despite the pending lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 一名法官裁定，尽管诉讼尚待裁决，三尼辛可以继续建设他们的城市。

sentences.en: But he warned them, if the environmentalists won their case against Rajneeshpuram, almost everything they built would have to come down.
sentences.zh: 但他警告他们，如果环保主义者赢得了针对拉杰尼什普拉姆的诉讼，他们建造的几乎所有东西都必须拆除。

sentences.en: The sannyasins were undaunted.
sentences.zh: 三尼辛并没有被吓退。

sentences.en: They worked 16-hour days, six days a week, building up their city.
sentences.zh: 他们每周工作六天，每天工作16个小时，建设他们的城市。

sentences.en: Here's Ma Ananda Sarita again.
sentences.zh: 这里又是玛·阿南达·萨里塔。

sentences.en: And so we would work all day, and usually that would go until midnight.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会工作一整天，通常会持续到半夜。

sentences.en: And then go to bed, and maybe have a lover, and make love all night, and then get up again in the morning and start over.
sentences.zh: 然后去睡觉，也许会有个爱人，整夜做爱，接着早上又起床重新开始。

sentences.en: Rajneesh taught his followers that meditation was the highest form of worship, and that work would be their meditation.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼什教导他的追随者，冥想是最高形式的崇拜，而工作就是他们的冥想。

sentences.en: A doctrine of relentless work is pretty convenient when you're trying to erect a city from scratch.
sentences.zh: 当你试图从零开始建造一座城市时，这种不间断工作的教义真是太方便了。

sentences.en: Of course, all that construction cost a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有这些建设花费了大量的资金。

sentences.en: Luckily, Rajneesh had a global network of lucrative communes that sent their revenue to Rajneeshpuram.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，拉杰尼什拥有一个利润丰厚的全球公社网络，他们将收入汇给拉杰尼什普拉姆。

sentences.en: Plus, the Guru's followers surrendered everything from their former lives.
sentences.zh: 此外，大师的追随者交出了他们过去生活中的一切。

sentences.en: They sold their jewelry, their cars, their homes, and gave it to the city.
sentences.zh: 他们卖掉了珠宝、汽车、房子，并把钱交给了城市。

sentences.en: The ranch was changing faSt.
sentences.zh: 牧场正在迅速改变。

sentences.en: The sannyasins arrived in 1981, but by 1983, they had built 140 small dams up and down the John Day River to slow the rate of erosion.
sentences.zh: 三尼辛于1981年抵达，但到1983年，他们已经在约翰戴伊河上下建造了140座小型水坝，以减缓侵蚀速度。

sentences.en: And it worked.
sentences.zh: 这很有效。

sentences.en: The dusty, golden valley was green.
sentences.zh: 尘土飞扬的金黄山谷变绿了。

sentences.en: We had an amazing organic farm with very, very nutritious vegetables.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有一个令人惊叹的有机农场，产出非常有营养的蔬菜。

sentences.en: Within the first couple years, the population jumped from a few hundred people to around 2,000.
sentences.zh: 在头几年内，人口从几百人激增到大约2000人。

sentences.en: And their farms produced almost everything they needed.
sentences.zh: 他们的农场生产了他们所需几乎所有的东西。

sentences.en: They also accomplished some pretty impressive feats of engineering.
sentences.zh: 他们还完成了一些相当令人瞩目的工程壮举。

sentences.en: They built a 45-acre reservoir held by a 400-foot earthen dam.
sentences.zh: 他们建造了一个45英亩的水库，由一座400英尺长的土坝支撑。

sentences.en: Not to mention a mass transit system composed of 85 school buses that zigzagged around Rajneeshpuram.
sentences.zh: 更不用说由85辆校车组成、在拉杰尼什普拉姆四处穿梭的公共交通系统了。

sentences.en: But while the citizens got around in school buses, the Guru preferred a Rolls-Royce.
sentences.zh: 但当市民们乘坐校车出行时，大师却更偏爱劳斯莱斯。

sentences.en: In fact, he owned 93 Rolls-Royces.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他拥有93辆劳斯莱斯。

sentences.en: And every day, in a kind of ritual, he'd drive around the city in one of them.
sentences.zh: 每天，他都会以某种仪式般的方式，乘坐其中一辆车在城里兜风。

sentences.en: At noon, and then again like at 5 o'clock, he would drive the roads.
sentences.zh: 在中午，然后大约在5点左右，他会开车巡视道路。

sentences.en: And people, the sannyasins, would line up along the roads, hands clasped in front of their faces,
sentences.zh: 人们，也就是三尼辛，会在道路两旁排成一行，双手在脸前合十，

sentences.en: and then just sort of being blissed out as he went by, and tears streaming down their faces.
sentences.zh: 当他从旁驶过时，他们便陷入一种极乐状态，泪水顺着脸颊流淌。

sentences.en: And they were just like, oh.
sentences.zh: 他们简直激动得无以复加。

sentences.en: Right around the time he moved to America, the Guru began a vow of silence.
sentences.zh: 就在他搬到美国前后，大师开始发誓禁言。

sentences.en: So these so-called drive-bys were one of the ways that Rajneesh communicated with his followers.
sentences.zh: 所以这些所谓的巡视车队成了拉杰尼什与追随者沟通的方式之一。

sentences.en: But it seemed like he also just really liked the feel of the open road.
sentences.zh: 但看起来他也确实很享受开阔道路的感觉。

sentences.en: And then he would hit the highway, and he would drive 100 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 然后他会驶上高速公路，以每小时100英里的速度狂飙。

sentences.en: I don't know how many tickets he got, and how many times he was threatened to have his license taken away.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他吃过多少罚单，也不知道他有多少次被威胁要吊销驾照。

sentences.en: But evidently, it was a lot.
sentences.zh: 但显然，次数相当多。

sentences.en: While Rajneesh was in silence, he set up a government for the ranch, an elite inner circle of female sannyasins.
sentences.zh: 在拉杰尼什禁言期间，他为牧场建立了一个政府，一个由女性三尼辛组成的精英核心圈子。

sentences.en: He wanted the commune to be a matriarchy, because he believed that women were less dominated by their egos.
sentences.zh: 他希望公社成为一个母系社会，因为他相信女性受自我意识的支配较少。

sentences.en: At the center of this circle was a woman named Ma Anand Sheila.
sentences.zh: 这个核心圈子的中心是一个名叫玛·阿南达·希拉的女人。

sentences.en: Sheila was Rajneesh's secretary and chief spokesperson.
sentences.zh: 希拉是拉杰尼什的秘书兼首席发言人。

sentences.en: She was one of the only people he spoke to during his long silence.
sentences.zh: 她是他漫长禁言期间少数几个能与之交谈的人之一。

sentences.en: Here's archival tape of Ma Anand Sheila.
sentences.zh: 这里是玛·阿南达·希拉的档案录音。

sentences.en: My purpose is to live with the living master, Bhagwam Shri Rajneesh, harmoniously with his people around here,
sentences.zh: 我的目的是和活着的精神导师薄伽梵·室利·拉杰尼希一起生活，与他周围的人们在这里和谐相处，

sentences.en: and live a very beautiful, rich life which we have here.
sentences.zh: 并过上我们在这里拥有的非常美好、丰富的生活。

sentences.en: Whenever Milt Ritter came to report on the ranch, Sheila would try to convince him to join the sannyasins.
sentences.zh: 每当米尔特·里特来牧场汇报情况时，希拉总是试图说服他加入三明尼辛。

sentences.en: And she says, you know, come on, it's, you know, what's to lose?
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，来吧，这，你知道的，有什么好失去的呢？

sentences.en: You know, everything is taken care of for you here, all your food is made for you, your laundry is done, you have housing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这里一切都为你打理好了，所有的饭菜都为你做好，衣服有人洗，你还有住房。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't you just do this?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不就这样做呢？

sentences.en: Sheila didn't convince Milt Ritter to move, but she had a very persuasive way about her.
sentences.zh: 希拉并没有说服米尔特·里特搬来，但她有一种非常具有说服力的方式。

sentences.en: And she was becoming more and more powerful.
sentences.zh: 而且她变得越来越有权势。

sentences.en: There was a kind of, we could call a power elite.
sentences.zh: 有一种我们可以称之为权力精英的东西。

sentences.en: So Sheila was considered to be the boss.
sentences.zh: 所以希拉被认为是老板。

sentences.en: At first, it seemed like Sheila wanted to have a good relationship with the surrounding Oregon community.
sentences.zh: 起初，看起来希拉似乎想与周边俄勒冈州的社区搞好关系。

sentences.en: She threw a party out at the ranch and invited the locals.
sentences.zh: 她在牧场举办了一场派对，并邀请了当地居民。

sentences.en: But it didn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: A lot of people think that it was Sheila that steered Rajneesh Purim into a dark chapter.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，正是希拉将拉杰尼希普拉姆带入了一个黑暗的篇章。

sentences.en: One that began with the neighboring town of Antelope.
sentences.zh: 一个始于邻近小镇安蒂洛普的篇章。

sentences.en: Antelope was a small community of about 40 people, mostly retirees.
sentences.zh: 安蒂洛普是一个大约有40人的小社区，大多是退休人员。

sentences.en: It was kind of a depressed little community.
sentences.zh: 它算是一个有些萧条的小社区。

sentences.en: It had a grocery store and maybe a gas station, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，它有一家杂货店，可能还有一个加油站。

sentences.en: And not a whole lot more.
sentences.zh: 除此之外就没有多少别的了。

sentences.en: The sannyasins saw an opportunity in Antelope.
sentences.zh: 三明尼辛在安蒂洛普看到了一个机会。

sentences.en: They knew the future of their commune was subject to the county's laws.
sentences.zh: 他们知道他们公社的未来受制于县里的法律。

sentences.en: If they had control of a town, an established town whose incorporation wasn't hanging in the balance,
sentences.zh: 如果他们能够控制一个城镇，一个其建制并非悬而未决的成熟城镇，

sentences.en: they could influence county policy and carve out a permanent place for themselves in Oregon.
sentences.zh: 他们就能影响县里的政策，并在俄勒冈州为自己开辟一个永久的立足之地。

sentences.en: So the sannyasins purchased vacant houses in town, moved their people in,
sentences.zh: 于是，三明尼辛买下了镇上的空置房屋，把他们的人搬了进去，

sentences.en: and generally made life in Antelope miserable.
sentences.zh: 并且总的来说让安蒂洛普的生活变得苦不堪言。

sentences.en: They harassed locals constantly, partied in their driveways, made fun of them on the street.
sentences.zh: 他们不断骚扰当地人，在别人的车道上开派对，在街上取笑他们。

sentences.en: And, just to intimidate people, they took photos of license plates and videotaped city council meetings.
sentences.zh: 而且，仅仅为了恐吓人们，他们拍摄车牌照片，并对市议会会议进行录像。

sentences.en: They were obviously given a mission.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他们被赋予了一项使命。

sentences.en: Take over the town of Antelope.
sentences.zh: 接管安蒂洛普镇。

sentences.en: Over the course of a couple years, the sannyasins stacked the city council and elected their own mayor.
sentences.zh: 在短短几年内，三明尼辛把持了市议会并选出了他们自己的市长。

sentences.en: They even took over Antelope's school and forced ranchers to bus their children to another town an hour away.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至接管了安蒂洛普的学校，强迫牧场主用巴士把他们的孩子送到一小时车程外的另一个城镇。

sentences.en: They ran the place.
sentences.zh: 他们统治了这个地方。

sentences.en: And eventually, they changed the name of Antelope to Rajneesh.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们将安蒂洛普的名字改成了拉杰尼希。

sentences.en: Another city named for their guru.
sentences.zh: 另一个以他们的导师命名的城市。

sentences.en: Now they were pissing people off.
sentences.zh: 现在他们把人们彻底惹火了。

sentences.en: Anti-Rajneesh sentiment spread like wildfire across the state.
sentences.zh: 反拉杰尼希的情绪在整个州像野火一样蔓延。

sentences.en: You started seeing bumper stickers that said,
sentences.zh: 你开始看到汽车保险杠贴纸上写着：

sentences.en: Better dead than red.
sentences.zh: 宁死也不要红色的。

sentences.en: A reference to the sannyasins' red clothing.
sentences.zh: 这是指三明尼辛穿的红色服装。

sentences.en: And some of this anti-Rajneesh sentiment turned violent.
sentences.zh: 其中一些反拉杰尼希的情绪演变成了暴力。

sentences.en: A hotel in Portland owned by the Rajneeshis was bombed, though no one was killed.
sentences.zh: 波特兰一家属于拉杰尼希信徒的酒店遭到炸弹袭击，所幸无人伤亡。

sentences.en: And both the guru and Sheila began receiving death threats.
sentences.zh: 导师和希拉都开始收到死亡威胁。

sentences.en: Sheila felt they were under attack.
sentences.zh: 希拉觉得他们受到了攻击。

sentences.en: Stop persecuting us once and for all.
sentences.zh: 一劳永逸地停止迫害我们吧。

sentences.en: And if they want to continue persecuting us, even though we are non-violent people,
sentences.zh: 如果他们想继续迫害我们，尽管我们是非暴力的人，

sentences.en: we will show them that we won't take this kind of harassment.
sentences.zh: 我们将向他们表明，我们不会默默忍受这种骚扰。

sentences.en: Rajneesh Puram's police force, they called it the peace force, started buying more and more weapons.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼希普拉姆的警察部队，他们称之为和平部队，开始购买越来越多的武器。

sentences.en: Sannyasins with rifles followed the guru everywhere.
sentences.zh: 带着步枪的三明尼辛信徒形影不离地跟随着导师。

sentences.en: Sheila carried a sidearm.
sentences.zh: 希拉随身携带手枪。

sentences.en: The city even had two helicopter reconnaissance teaMs.
sentences.zh: 这座城市甚至有两个直升机侦察小队。

sentences.en: And then there were demonstrations that they would show to the media at their firing range
sentences.zh: 然后，他们会在靶场向媒体展示

sentences.en: of all these automatic and semi-automatic weapons that they had.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有的所有这些自动和半自动武器的示威活动。

sentences.en: And they had a lot of them.
sentences.zh: 而且他们拥有数量庞大的武器。

sentences.en: The takeover of Antelope, the brandishing of weapons, it was all too much.
sentences.zh: 对安蒂洛普的接管，对武器的挥舞，这一切都太过分了。

sentences.en: State and county politicians got together and put the bureaucratic smackdown on Rajneesh Puram.
sentences.zh: 州和县的政治家们联合起来，对拉杰尼希普拉姆实施了官僚主义的重拳打击。

sentences.en: First, the Oregon Land Conservation and Development Commission amended their rules.
sentences.zh: 首先，俄勒冈州土地保护和发展委员会修改了他们的规则。

sentences.en: Now counties would have to check with the state before allowing a new city to incorporate.
sentences.zh: 现在，县里在允许新城市建制之前必须先与州里核实。

sentences.en: The new rule was retroactive to right around the time Rajneesh Puram was incorporated.
sentences.zh: 新规则具有追溯效力，追溯到拉杰尼希普拉姆建制前后的时候。

sentences.en: And then a county judge stalled all construction in Rajneesh Puram.
sentences.zh: 接着，一名县法官叫停了拉杰尼希普拉姆的所有建设。

sentences.en: No more building until their status as a city was sorted out.
sentences.zh: 在他们作为城市的地位厘清之前，不准再进行建设。

sentences.en: Rajneesh Puram seemed to be losing the battle to exist as a city.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼希普拉姆似乎正在失去作为城市生存下去的斗争。

sentences.en: Here is county planner Dan Duro again.
sentences.zh: 这里又是县规划师丹·杜罗。

sentences.en: And it wasn't long after that too, I think, that they then began to move in the street people
sentences.zh: 而且在那之后不久，我想，他们就开始把来自全国各地的流浪汉

sentences.en: from around the country and bussing them in and housing them there on the ranch.
sentences.zh: 用巴士运进来，并将他们安置在那里的牧场上。

sentences.en: In the fall of 1984, Sheila announced that the Sanyasins would open their city to the homeless.
sentences.zh: 1984年秋天，希拉宣布三明尼辛将向无家可归者开放他们的城市。

sentences.en: Their idea was that if we can bring in enough people to live here and we can convince them
sentences.zh: 他们的想法是，如果我们能带来足够多的人住在这里，并且我们能说服他们

sentences.en: to vote for the Rajneesh candidates, we could actually get a couple of people on the county
sentences.zh: 投票给拉杰尼希的候选人，我们实际上就能在县议会里安插几个人

sentences.en: council and maybe get some things going our way.
sentences.zh: 说不定能让一些事情按照我们的意愿发展。

sentences.en: Sheila denied that the new residents were there just to vote.
sentences.zh: 希拉否认新居民来这里只是为了投票。

sentences.en: She claimed she wanted to share the bounty with them and named the initiative the Share-A-Home
sentences.zh: 她声称她想与他们分享财富，并将该倡议命名为“分享家园”计划。

sentences.en: program.

sentences.en: And I'm grateful that they're ready to share with us.

sentences.en: But behind the scenes, the new residents weren't treated well.

sentences.zh: 有一长串希拉和她的副手们在过去几年里犯下的罪恶勾当。

sentences.zh: 声称她只是奉其精神导师之命行事。

sentences.en: Did you really not know what was going on in Antelope?
sentences.zh: 她的判决是：在加利福尼亚州普莱森顿服刑三项同时执行的20年有期徒刑。

sentences.en: No, when I was silent, I was completely unaware.
sentences.zh: 导师也被起诉了，但罪名较轻。

sentences.en: When I was silent, I was completely unaware.
sentences.zh: 他获得了五年缓刑，罚款40万美元，并被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: That's an archival recording of Bhagwan Sri Rajneesh.
sentences.zh: 当时，整个牧场几乎陷入了完全停顿的状态。

sentences.en: Soon, Sheila was extradited from West Germany on a slew of charges.
sentences.zh: 这些人都在悲伤。

sentences.en: She pled guilty, but said Rajneesh was the mastermind.
sentences.zh: 然后拉杰尼希普拉姆解散了。

sentences.en: That she was only acting on behalf of her spiritual master.
sentences.zh: 一切都在被拍卖。

sentences.en: Her sentence, three concurrent 20-year terms to be served in Pleasanton, California.
sentences.zh: 从劳斯莱斯到警察制服，应有尽有。

sentences.en: The guru was also charged, but for lesser crimes.
sentences.zh: 拍卖结束后，这里成了一座鬼城。

sentences.en: He got five years probation, $400,000 in fines, and he was deported.
sentences.zh: 萨里塔是最后离开的三明尼辛信徒之一。

sentences.en: It was, the whole ranch just kind of ground to a standstill.
sentences.zh: 她承认事情大错特错，但她对他们在拉杰尼希普拉姆建立的一切依然感觉良好。

sentences.en: These people were grieving.
sentences.zh: 尽管它没有持续下去，但事实是，在好几年里，我们彼此生活在非常非常美丽的和谐之中。

sentences.en: And then Rajneesh Puram dissolved.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个了不起的成就。

sentences.en: Everything was being auctioned off.
sentences.zh: 我认为它可以作为一种模范。

sentences.en: Everything from Rolls Royces to police uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 因此，存在某种权力游戏以及这些破坏性元素的事实，你在任何地方都能找到。

sentences.en: After the auction, it was a ghost town.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼希回到了印度，在那里他以另一个名字奥修继续担任精神领袖。

sentences.en: Sarita was one of the last sannyasins to leave.
sentences.zh: 他在1990年因心脏衰竭去世，但他的教义至今仍在全球拥有众多追随者。

sentences.en: She admits things went terribly awry, but she still feels good about what they built in Rajneesh Puram.
sentences.zh: 希拉在她20年的刑期中只服刑了大约两年。

sentences.en: Even though it didn't last, the fact is that for a number of years, we were living in a very, very beautiful harmony with each other.
sentences.zh: 她因表现良好而被提前释放。

sentences.en: So, this was an amazing achievement.
sentences.zh: 现在她住在瑞士，在那里她拥有面向老年人和残疾人的疗养院。

sentences.en: And I think it can serve as a model.
sentences.zh: 我认为这可以作为一个榜样。

sentences.en: So, the fact that there was some kind of power games going on and there was these destructive elements, that you will find anywhere.
sentences.zh: 因此，存在某种权力游戏以及这些破坏性元素的事实，你在任何地方都能找到。

sentences.en: Rajneesh returned to India, where he continued to be a spiritual leader under a different name, Osho.
sentences.zh: 拉杰尼什回到印度，在那里他以另一个名字“奥修”继续担任精神领袖。

sentences.en: He died of heart failure in 1990, but his teachings still command a global following.
sentences.zh: 他于1990年因心力衰竭去世，但他的教导依然拥有全球追随者。

sentences.en: Sheila only served about two years of her 20-year sentence.
sentences.zh: 希拉在她20年的刑期中只服刑了大约两年。

sentences.en: She was released early for good behavior.
sentences.zh: 她因表现良好而被提前释放。

sentences.en: Now she lives in Switzerland, where she owns nursing homes for the elderly and disabled.
sentences.zh: 现在她住在瑞士，在那里她拥有一家为老人和残疾人服务的疗养院。

sentences.en: Today, the city that the sannyasins left behind has been transformed into a different kind of community.
sentences.zh: 今天，门徒们留下的这座城市已经变成了一个完全不同的社区。

sentences.en: My co-producer, Stephen, and I went out to where Rajneesh Puram used to be.
sentences.zh: 我的联合制作人斯蒂芬和我去了罗杰尼希普拉姆的原址。

sentences.en: We drove down the long gravel road and descended down into the valley that is now home to one of the largest youth Christian camps in the country,
sentences.zh: 我们沿着漫长的砂石路行驶，驶入山谷，这里现在是全国最大的青少年基督教营地之一所在地，

sentences.en: owned and operated by an organization called Young Life.
sentences.zh: 由一个名为“年轻生命”的组织拥有和运营。

sentences.en: The meditation hall where sannyasins used to gather is now a massive sports complex with a batting cage, four basketball courts, ping-pong tables, you name it.
sentences.zh: 门徒们曾经聚集的冥想大厅现在成了一个巨大的体育综合体，里面有击球练习笼、四个篮球场、乒乓球桌，应有尽有。

sentences.en: The old hotel is now a dormitory.
sentences.zh: 旧酒店现在成了一栋宿舍。

sentences.en: Occasionally, they use the airstrip the sannyasins left behind to fly in international campers.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，他们会利用门徒们留下的简易机场接送国际营员。

sentences.en: Rajneesh Puram isn't a city anymore.
sentences.zh: 罗杰尼希普拉姆已经不再是一座城市了。

sentences.en: It's now called the Washington Family Ranch and is under county jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 它现在被称为华盛顿家庭牧场，受县司法管辖。

sentences.en: It's still a place for religious seekers, but not the kind that want to build a utopia.
sentences.zh: 这里依然是宗教寻道者的去处，但不是那种想要建立乌托邦的人。

sentences.en: Just thousands of Christian teens looking to have, quote, the best week of their lives.
sentences.zh: 只有成千上万的基督教青少年，渴望度过他们所谓的“生命中最棒的一周”。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Chloe Prasinos and Stephen Jackson.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由克洛伊·普拉西诺斯和斯蒂芬·杰克逊制作。

sentences.en: With Katie Mingle, Avery Truffleman, Sam Greenspan, Kurt Kolstad, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与制作的还有凯蒂·明格、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼、萨姆·格林斯潘、库尔特·科尔stad以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Special thanks to the Oregon Historical Society for the use of their archive.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢俄勒冈历史学会允许我们使用他们的档案。

sentences.en: And this episode also features a bunch of music from Hamasha, whose first album just came out.
sentences.zh: 本期节目还收录了哈玛莎的大量音乐，她的首张专辑刚刚发行。

sentences.en: It is going to be big.
sentences.zh: 这张专辑一定会大火。

sentences.en: I like the album so much, I decided to put the full vocal version of the first song on the album at the end of this episode.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这张专辑了，以至于决定把专辑中第一首歌的完整人声版放在本集节目的末尾。

sentences.en: So stay tuned, and you're going to have your new favorite song.
sentences.zh: 所以请继续收听，你们将听到你们的新最爱歌曲。

sentences.en: You heard it here firSt.
sentences.zh: 你们在这里最先听到。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco and produced out of the offices of ArcSign, an architecture and interiors firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 KALW 的一个项目，制作于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心的一家建筑与室内设计公司 ArcSign 的办公室里。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter, Tumblr, Instagram, and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我们都在 Twitter、Tumblr、Instagram 和 Spotify 上。

sentences.en: The pictures and supplementary material about Rajneesh Parham are particularly fascinating, so you don't want to miss those at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 关于罗杰尼希普拉姆的照片和补充资料格外引人入胜，所以你千万不要错过 99pi.org 上的这些内容。

sentences.en: And as a little treat, as promised, here's For Love from the Law from the debut self-titled album by Hamasha.
sentences.zh: 作为如约而至的小福利，以下是来自哈玛莎同名首张专辑的《For Love from the Law》。

sentences.en: Do you like that song?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这首歌吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 喜欢。

sentences.en: Do you think people are still listening?
sentences.zh: 你觉得大家还在听吗？
